description:
## 0.0.0

- chore: bump to 0.0.0
- fix: publish a bundle Android can actually load
- docs: make the Morphe install link a button
- chore: order pre-releases the way Morphe does, and require -dev.N
- chore: drop the semantic-release remnants the restore brought back
- feat: swipe right to undo the last delete
- feat: grey out the Gboard glide rows Flexboard writes for itself
- fix: write the settings to the file Gboard actually reads
- feat: add a switch to turn swipe-to-delete on and off
- docs: update the roadmap notes
- fix: stop the Flexboard settings screen clipping its first row
- chore: stop opening a pull request to promote to main
- fix: launch the Flexboard settings by component, not by action
- fix: open the Flexboard settings from an Activity, not a nested screen
- feat: turn Gboard's flick-for-symbols on by default
- feat: add a max-words-per-swipe cap
- feat: add a Flexboard settings screen with swipe length and hold delay
- fix: stop the flick fix crashing Gboard with a VerifyError
- fix: make the swipe register on a flick instead of a held drag
- feat: force Gboard's scrub delete on and glide typing off
